SELECT DISTINCT h.name
FROM Highschooler h
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM Friend f
    WHERE f.student_id = h.ID
)
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM Likes l
    WHERE l.student_id = h.ID
);
